text: Maya Patel: Quick thought from today's UI review — can we agree on a small set of rules for validation UX? I'm leaning toward inline errors for single-field problems, and a compact error summary for cross-field or submit-time failures. Samir Khan: +1 for inline for simple cases. Accessibility note: inline errors need aria-live so screen readers announce them immediately. For the summary, make it a focusable region with links to fields. Henry Li: Re destructive actions: current 'Are you sure?' modal is too vague. Suggest stronger copy and an action-level escalation. Example: ``` Title: Delete Dataset Body: This will permanently delete the dataset "training-run-42" and all associated logs. This cannot be undone. Checkbox: I understand that this action is permanent. Primary button: Delete dataset ``` Only show the typed-confirmation for org-level or multi-resource deletes. For one-off items, use an undo toast instead. Lia Gomez: I like the escalation idea — reduces friction for simple tasks. Also: required-marker debate — do we show an asterisk on every required field or only label groupings? My concern: too many asterisks look noisy on dense forms. Maya Patel: Proposal: show a global short note "* indicates required" on long forms + only mark out-of-band required fields (e.g., email). For compact forms, inline hint 'required' next to label works. Also, color-only marker is not OK for contrast. Samir Khan: Accessibility nit: required markers must have text for screen readers (e.g., required). Also ensure error states don't rely on color alone — add icons or ARIA descriptors. Henry Li: On error summaries, let's keep the copy actionable: "There are 3 problems preventing submission" and anchor links like "Fix email address". Avoid generic "Invalid input" messages. Lia Gomez: Microcopy suggestion for inline errors — short + helpful + next step. Examples: - "Enter a valid email (example: name@company.com)" - "Password too weak — add >8 chars and a number" Maya Patel: UX pattern we should document in the components library: 1) Inline error for single-field validator failures (on blur and submit). 2) Top summary for submit-time/cross-field failures with links to fields. 3) Required marker: asterisk + global note, never color-only. 4) Delete confirmations: undo toast for low-risk, checkbox confirm for medium, typed confirm for high-risk. Samir Khan: I'll draft an accessibility checklist to attach to the design doc: aria-live regions, role=alert for inline, focus management to summary on submit, sr-only required text, keyboard-only dismissal rules. design-bot: Design doc updated — added "forms-validation-patterns.md" in the repo with the hybrid patterns above. Link: https://redwood.internal/design/forms-validation-patterns (edited) :sparkles: Maya Patel: Perfect — thanks @Samir @Lia. Next step: Samir, can you post the A11y checklist? Lia, can you mock the delete modal variants by EOD? I'll consolidate and update the components page. :thumbsup:
